interface.longDescription: Log in to Quantus once, then run backtests over the longest period the data covers, look at Korean and US stock data, turn an order sentence into a confirm card. Orders are never sent from chat: you press confirm on the Quantus screen. Quantus is not investment advice, and results may differ from real-account performance.
defaultPrompt: Backtest Samsung Electronics over the longest period.
Show me the financial snapshot of NVDA.
Make a confirm card to buy 1 share of Samsung Electronics.
